query: SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM graphile_worker.jobs WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE), 0) AS "queued!: i64" , COALESCE( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM webhook_deliveries WHERE delivered_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND tenant_id = $1), 0) AS "delivered_today!: i64", COALESCE( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dead_letter_queue WHERE abandoned_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND tenant_id = $1), 0) AS "failed_today!: i64", COALESCE( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dead_letter_queue WHERE tenant_id = $1), 0) AS "dlq_total!: i64"
